text.tspan: - High resolution, Low resolution or Off.
- Ten colours: resource bar, swing bar, bar background, spark, text, accent,

svg.text: borders, window background, combo points, icon border. Click one to open a colour wheel.

text.tspan: - Pick on the wheel and the brightness bar. Changes show at once. Done keeps it,

svg.text: Cancel puts the old colour back.

text.tspan: - The four see-through parts (bar background, borders, window background, icon border)
- Tick to use your colours, untick for the plain skin. A part you have not
- Type a name and press Save to keep a colour set (up to 40). Load lists

svg.text: the saved sets. They survive Reset to default.

text.tspan: - Click one. A skin is a palette plus an edge style (flat, line, bevel, rune, ember,

svg.text: frost, gilded). It only recolours; it never moves or resizes anything.
